decisions.reason: As a combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot, it fits the firm's strategy of delivering integrated, high-automation precast solutions and is too strategically aligned to withdraw after only one year.
The automatic de-shuttering robot should be kept because modular standalone automation options suit retrofit projects and customers who cannot yet invest in a full combined system.
The profile storage robot complements plant-wide automation and material flow efficiency, which strengthens the firm's broad systems offering and lifecycle value proposition.
The automatic shuttering robot should be retained because it expands the firm's configurable product range for different plant layouts, automation stages, and customer investment budgets.
